newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tamro eyes Denmark growth, divestments.
newsitem.headline: Tamro eyes Denmark growth, divestments.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Oy Tamro Ab said on Friday it was looking at prospects to expand distribution into Denmark, and said it would go on divesting non-core businesses.

"We are charting the possibilities of further expanding the operations of the Medical and Laboratory division and extending distribution services to cover Denmark," Tamro said in a statement with its 1996 results.
"The divestment of units and holdings outside the core business will be continued," it said, but gave no details.
The statement did not give any profit forecast.
